name: Studio 3D
description: Text-based 3D modelling: scenes are YAML (shapes, booleans, groups, repeat/scatter, modifiers, PBR materials, pack models) built to .glb with a 4-view preview PNG and stats. Textures: image files, studio-image pictures and procedural textures with box / planar / cylinder / sphere / fit mapping, relief and more maps. Smooth or flat shading, exports for games (.glb), other tools (.obj) and 3D printing (.stl). The website has a visual 3D editor for the same scene files. Extensible with Python shape/modifier plugins.

commands.description: build .glb + stats (+ 4-view PNG to look at); stl for 3D printing, obj for other tools
render perspective/front/side/top views of any model
triangles, size, materials, textures of any model — and the scene file it was built from
shapes, modifiers and pack models with parameters
material presets, pack materials and material options
procedural textures (from studio-image), UV projections, texture maps, pictures of the project
extend the tool with your own Python shape/modifier (plugins/3d/)

formats.description: scene: materials + objects (studio-3d docs) — opens in the website's 3D editor
